name: Hyperpigmentation of the Skin

ethnicAssociations: Higher prevalence in individuals of African, Asian, and Hispanic descent

criteria.description: Presence of localized or diffuse areas of increased skin pigmentation
Wood's lamp examination showing accentuation of pigmentation in epidermal hyperpigmentation
Skin biopsy demonstrating increased melanin deposition in basal keratinocytes or dermal melanophages

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Clinical identification of increased pigmentation with or without supportive Wood's lamp examination or histopathology
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical; biopsy is reserved for atypical or uncertain cases.

common.notes: Symmetric hyperpigmented macules on sun-exposed areas
Pigmentation following skin injury or inflammation
Small, light brown macules on sun-exposed skin

occasional.notes: Velvety hyperpigmented plaques typically in intertriginous areas
Diffuse bronze pigmentation associated with adrenal insufficiency

rare.notes: Bronze skin discoloration due to iron overload
Dark brown macules in sun-exposed and flexural areas

searchTerms: dark spots on lips and mouth

laboratory: Serum cortisol and ACTH levels in suspected Addison's disease
Serum ferritin and transferrin saturation in hemochromatosis
imaging: Abdominal MRI or CT for adrenal or hepatic pathology if indicated
genetic: Genetic testing for hemochromatosis (HFE gene mutations)
Genetic testing for Peutz-Jeghers syndrome (STK11 gene mutations)
other: Wood's lamp examination to differentiate epidermal vs dermal pigmentation

distinguishingFeatures: Symmetric hyperpigmented macules primarily on the face
Associated with hormonal changes and sun exposure
Diffuse bronze pigmentation with systemic symptoms of adrenal insufficiency
Electrolyte abnormalities and low cortisol levels
Bronze skin pigmentation with iron overload
Elevated serum ferritin and transferrin saturation

redFlags: Associated systemic symptoms such as weight loss, fatigue, or electrolyte imbalance
Pigmentation with mucosal involvement or ulceration
references: James WD, Berger TG, Elston DM. Andrews' Diseases of the Skin: Clinical Dermatology. 13th ed. Elsevier; 2020.
Orphanet: Hyperpigmentation of the skin - ORPHA:79375
Bolognia JL, Schaffer JV, Cerroni L. Dermatology. 4th ed. Elsevier; 2018.
